material_protocol.comparison: same 300 x 300 micrometre square physical aperture; only the motif and Bravais lattice differ
material_protocol.square_motif: one central main hole and one independently placed diagonal satellite
material_protocol.triangular_motif: one central main hole and two independently placed diagonal-direction satellites
material_protocol.period_rule: Screening starts at unperturbed Bragg 1030nm. Final outer design changes period only after independently closing the actual lowest sampled pole, to target actual emission 1030 +/-0.01nm. The resulting physical period is then fixed for all competing modes and TE families.

pump_comparisons.power_definition: total internal first-entry W across both 300um x 500nm gain-edge faces
internal first-entry W over the common 300um x 300um top face

material_protocol.far_field: complex Ex/Ey emission from each actual finite eigenfield; +/-1 degree window only when the original envelope sampling supports it
material_protocol.polarization: common pcselsim.polarization module; angular trapezoid integration; S3=+2 Im(Ex Ey*); no handedness label
material_protocol.scope: Scalar weak-modulation TE CWT; six independent retained waves for triangular lattice; same stratified Green kernel for damping and flux; shared x-z inversion with y averaged. Not full-vector Maxwell, TM, thermal or dynamic stability certification.
material_protocol.final_census: Residual-verified complete coarse QZ (square N17, triangular N9) lowest40, analytic continuous counterpropagating stripe challenges with high perpendicular seeds, Gamma and wide supplements; fixed-period independently closed modes and shared inversion; bounded sampled spectrum only
material_protocol.legacy_rule_name_note: Earlier YAG rule name swapped span/gap in its text; numeric JSON fields and actual computation have always been gap40nm and caliper50nm, identical to semiconductor rules. Frozen square_v2 metadata retains the original label for hash stability.

declared_scope: outer period designed at actual low-loss emission near 1030nm, then fixed-period real-frequency scalar TE CWT poles; bounded sparse lateral census; shared x-z inversion with y averaged; no TM, full-wave certification, thermal model or dynamic single-mode proof
